recipe.visualDefinition: A formal studio portrait of a man and woman in 1970s evening wear, set against a dark, moody blue-grey vignette background, featuring highly ornate, interlocking white script typography in the upper left quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Interlocking swashes of the script mirroring the physical closeness of the subjects
High-contrast white lettering against a dark, desaturated background
Warm skin tones and formal black textures balanced by cool-toned studio lighting
coreInvariants: Dark vignette background with a subtle blue-grey gradient
Formal 1970s styling including ruffled shirts and voluminous hair
Ornate, Spencerian-influenced script with extreme flourishes

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are seated, occupying the lower two-thirds and right half of the frame in a medium-full shot.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The woman's face and the man's hand resting on her arm form the central emotional anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the ornate typography in the top left, follows the curve of the man's shoulder down to the interlocking hands, and rests on the faces.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant dark space in the upper left and bottom foreground to allow for text and depth.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and muted navy (background and formal wear)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm amber and mahogany (skin tones and jewelry)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the environment with high value contrast on the text and facial highlights.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or modern digital vibrance

letterConstructionRules: Extreme circular swashes on all capital letters
Interlocking descenders and ascenders that fill negative space
High stroke contrast between thick downs Strokes and hairline connectors
Terminals ending in tight, elegant curls
characterSpecificRedesigns: Uppercase M and B feature oversized loops that extend above the x-height
The ampersand is integrated into the flow of the surrounding letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Ornate, expressive script paired with a restrained, classic serif for legibility.

preserve: The interlocking nature of the script

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary formal swashes and high contrast.
Captures the 1970s interpretation of classic calligraphy.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a Black man and woman in 1970s formal attire. The woman has voluminous hair and a black dress; the man has an afro, goatee, and a tuxedo with a ruffled shirt. They are posed closely. Background is a dark, moody blue-grey vignette. Soft, directional studio lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, white, interlocking Spencerian script in the top left corner. The script should feature extreme circular flourishes. Above it, add a small line of classic serif text in white.

verificationChecks: Does the script interlock without becoming illegible?
Is the background a smooth, dark vignette?
Do the subjects' outfits reflect mid-70s formal fashion?
Is the lighting soft and characteristic of film photography?

adjustableVariables: Warmth of the skin tone highlights
postGenerationChecks: Check for 1970s stylistic accuracy in hair and clothing
Ensure the white text pops against the dark background
Verify the interlocking swashes feel intentional and balanced
Confirm the vignette doesn't obscure facial details
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + 1970s Formalwear + Dark Vignette + Interlocking Spencerian Script = Soulful Duo Aesthetic
